Maximum OccupancyThe maximum occupancy of the development, during the standard hours of 07:00 - 22:00 on any day, shall be 50 apart from Friday between 13:00-13:30 whereby a maximum of 90 persons would be permitted. The maximum number of people includes all attendees, staff and mashalls. Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring residents
3. Hours of OperationThe use of the premises shall be restricted to the following hours 07:00 - 22:00. Reason: ​​​​​​​To protect the amenity of nearby residents

Prior to the commencement of development, a full Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Travel Plan shall expand upon the draft version submitted at application stage, providing detailed measures to promote sustainable travel, including monitoring and implementation strategies. The development shall operate in accordance with the approved Travel Plan thereafter.

Noise Management PlanThe premises shall be managed and operated in accordance with the
     Noise Management Plan referred to in section 9.3 “Noise Management Plan”
     and in accordance with the details provided in Appendix D of the Noise
     Impact Assessment Report reference:  28913.NIA.01 Rev C by KP
     Acoustics Limited.

Sound
Insulation Scheme.
Within three months from the date of this permission, the approved scheme for upgrading sound insulation between the non-residential premises and the adjoining noise-sensitive receiver shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved details. This shall include the measures set out in section 8.1 of the Noise Impact Assessment Report (ref: 28913.NIA.01 Rev C by KP Acoustics Limited), including the recommended works to the perimeter walls to minimise flanking transmission..

Before any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) plant , to which the application refers, is used at the premises, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (LPA) which demonstrates that the following noise design requirements can be complied with and shall thereafter be retained as approved.a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant to which the application refers, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 5dB at all times when the plant is in operation.Measurements shall be made at a height of 1.2 – 1.5 metres above the adjacent ground level and at least 3.5 metres from any sound reflecting surfaces other than  the ground or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor   (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard BS4142:2014.  The measurement value shall be adjusted to remove the additional sound energy contribution from reflected surfaces other than from the ground. An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved.b)At all times the plant shall be isolated to ensure that vibration amplitudes which causes re-radiated noise do not exceed the limits detailed in table 4 in section 7.7.2 of BS8233:2014 “Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings” OR The plant shall be supported on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to reduce the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.c) A commissioning acoustic test and report shall be undertaken within 7 days of mechanical services commissioning to demonstrate that conditions a) and b) above have been achieved. The results of the test shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:</p><ul><li>Site Location Plan (drawing no.: 1902/09, dated: February 2025)</li><li>Proposed Block Plan (drawing no.: 0904/12, dated: April 2025)</li><li>Proposed Elevations (drawing no.: 0904/11, dated: April 2025)</li><li>Proposed Floor Plan&nbsp;(drawing no.: 0904/09, dated: April 2025)</li><li>Proposed Roof Plan (drawing no.: 0904/10, dated: April 2025)</li></ul><p>Other documents:</p><ul><li>Design and Access Statement (received: 14/03/2025)</li><li>Needs Assessment Report (received: 14/03/2025)</li><li>Cover Letter (dated: 06/03/2025)</li><li>Site and Marketing Letter (dated: 26/02/2025)</li><li>Draft Travel Plan (dated: May 2025)</li><li>Transport Statement (dated: May 2025)</li><li>Noise Impact Assessment (28913.NIA.01, revision C, dated: 19/05/2025)</li><li>Noise Consultancy response letter (dated: 19/05/2025</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
